name: LOD-Aware Hierarchical Isosurface Search
definition: A recursive search algorithm on a hierarchical voxel tree (LOD-tree) to identify cells containing an isosurface at a specific isovalue and level-of-detail (LOD). It prunes branches based on min/max data values and LOD keys.
summary: LOD-Aware Hierarchical Isosurface Search is a recursive algorithm that dynamically extracts isosurfaces from volumetric data by pruning search branches based on min/max values and LOD keys, distinguishing itself through a three-key cyclic search strategy.
